name: Deception: Murder in Hong Kong

categories.label: Investigators (and Forensic Scientist) won
categories.hint: An Investigator correctly named both the Key Evidence and the Means of Murder

categories.label: Murderer team won
categories.hint: Murderer and Accomplice win if the crime is not solved

winCondition: Investigators and the Forensic Scientist win if an Investigator names both the Key Evidence and Means of Murder correctly. Otherwise the Murderer wins, together with the Accomplice if present, even if the Murderer is identified.

roles.label: Investigator
roles.winCondition: Name the Key Evidence and Means of Murder

roles.label: Witness
roles.winCondition: Knows the Murderer and Accomplice but not the solution; wins with the Investigators

endCondition.description: Each Investigator gets one guess (a badge); game ends when the crime is solved or all guesses are used

notes: family: hidden-role-social. Official rulebook PDF unavailable (BGG login wall); verified via UltraBoardGames and Wikipedia. Witness win side and the one-guess-per-Investigator limit come from general game knowledge and are not confirmed by a fetched source. Three rounds of clue tile changes not modelled; expansion roles not modelled.
